pairs.title: Argentine peso in US dollars
pairs.description: How many US dollars AR$1,000 buys. A rising number means a stronger Argentine peso. Starts in 1992, with the current peso, introduced in 1992; earlier years are in older currency units.
pairs.source: World Bank series PA.NUS.FCRF · official exchange rate, annual average, shown as 1,000 ÷ the published ARS per US$.
